commit.message:
LU-20298 build: support for gcc-16 and Fedora 44

In function 'format_param':
 'strncat; specified bound depends on the length of the source.
The length of suffix is known so avoid using strlen() here.
Also param_name length is stable, so only use strlen() once.

In function 'mntdf':
 int total_field_count = 0; is set but not used, remove it.
 the resulting temp_fields has no effect, remove it.

In function 'lustre_lnet_show_net':
 net_num is set but not used, remove it.

In function ll_dir_finish_open:
 initialize rc to 0
